notes: «وهو القطان» is an identifying gloss on «يحيى»: left out (rules 1 and 9)
«حدثنا أبي» is the father of Ibn Numayr, named only by relation: kind relation (rule 7)
«كلاهما، عن عبيد الله» is the join: both branches meet at «عبيد الله»; «بهذا الإسناد مثله» is a back_reference, no previous report supplied
